'''Troos''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
During the reign of [[Xim's empire]], the planet was known as '''Vynx'''.<ref name="Atlas" />

==Description==
Troos was located on the edge of the [[Radama Void/Legends|Radama Void]]. It was a wild, forested world that was home to a dizzying variety of arthropods.<ref name="Atlas" /> The world was covered in subarctic forests and [[Troos armored crebik|armored crebik]] and [[Bahl fly]] were native to this world.
